summary: Authorities in Malegaon, India, have asked residents to take a 'mugshot' of their cattle and submit it to the police . Police officials believe this is the only way to solve cow slaughter cases and enforce the law . Beef traders in the country strongly reacted to the decision and called a month-long strike .

A 21-year-old quadriplegic with cerebral palsy was left lying in a Philadelphia park for more than four days . Police say the man's mother left him in the park with only a blanket and a Bible . She is charged with aggravated assault, simple assault, reckless endangerment of another person .

Mountaineers have returned to Mount Everest for this year's climbing season after a deadly season last year . In April, a piece of glacial ice fell, unleashing an avalanche that killed 16 Nepalis . The route through Khumbu Icefall, the notoriously treacherous path where the 16 were killed, has been changed to one that takes longer but is safer .

Stephen Hawking has teamed with Monty Python to recreate "Galaxy Song" from their 1983 film "The Meaning of Life" The collabo is in honor of Saturday's Record Store Day, when the 7-inch single will be available for sale . It's not Hawking's first music gig; he's also featured on Pink Floyd song "Talkin' Hawkin'"

Saudi Arabia bombed Yemen last month in the name of "restoring the legitimate government" and protecting a "Yemeni constitution and elections" Peter Bergen: The kingdom's real motives seem clear if one looks at Saudi history of not allowing regional competition of any kind . He says the Saudi goal is simple: Prevent rise of any popularly supported government in the region that seeks self-determination .

Jamal al-Labani, 45, is believed to be the first U.S. citizen killed in the current violence in Yemen . He was hit in the back by shrapnel from a mortar shell, his family says . The Council on American-Islamic Relations says it's helping Yemeni-Americans trapped in the conflict . The State Department says there are no current plans to evacuate private citizens .

Charlotte Dujardin and Valegro win their second consecutive Reem Acra FEI World Cup Dressage title in Las Vegas . The French rider says she is "living the dream" as she cements her status as a dressage legend . Edward Gal and Glock's Undercover were second with 84.696, ahead of Germany's Jessica von Bredow-Werndl and Unee BB .

ISIS documents give a window into the bureaucracy of the self-declared caliphate . Documents relate to matters such as vaccination schedules, fishing methods and rent disputes . ISIS sees itself as a government operating under a rule of law, even if the group is most often talked about for its barbaric punishment .

Cystic fibrosis patients shouldn't be near each other because they can share infections that could cripple their already fragile lungs . Katie Donovan and Dalton Prager met on Facebook in August 2009 . The couple's health quickly deteriorated, and within months, the new husband and wife went on oxygen full time .

UltraHaptics' technology creates tactile three-dimensional shapes literally out of thin air, using ultrasound . The company's tagline says it all: "Feeling without touching" Through an emission of sound waves, sensations are projected through the air and to the user . Creating buttons and shapes literally anywhere they're needed opens up a slew of possibilities for traditional devices .

A 1973 E-Type Jaguar has been involved in a head-on collision with a Toyota Kluger . All three adults were taken to hospital as a precaution . The crash occurred on Warringah Road in Frenchs Forest, northern Sydney . The $120,000 Jaguar was completely written off in the collision . NSW police are still investigating the circumstances surrounding the crash .

Wigan Warriors beat St Helens 12-4 at the DW Stadium on Good Friday . Dom Manfredi and Louie McCarthy-Scarsbrook scored the opening tries for Wigan . Joe Burgess scored a late try to break the champions' resistance . It was a second successive defeat for Saints, who began the season with six wins in a row .

Five staff members left Royal Easter Show with serious injuries after taking a joy ride on 'the Super Slide' The 52-metre slide was closed after heavy rain made it too dangerous . The thrill seekers were travelling at such great speeds they were unable to stop eventually running into a barricade at the bottom of the slide . A 22-year-old woman broke both her legs, a 60-year old man suffered broken ribs and internal bleeding . The slide underwent a safety check Sunday morning and was cleared for use as long as there wasn't another downpour .

Brendan Rodgers says Raheem Sterling will not be going anywhere this summer . Sterling has been offered a new £100,000-a-week contract to stay at Anfield . The 20-year-old has revealed he is 'flattered' by interest from Arsenal . The Liverpool boss says Sterling's interview was conducted without the consent of the club and 'took them by surprise' Rodgers says Liverpool are a 'superpower' of world football and don't have to sell their best players .

Greg Gibbins, 28, was stabbed in the chest in the early hours of Easter Monday morning . He was treated at the scene by paramedics before he went into cardiac arrest but later died . A 20-year-old man, who police confirmed to Daily Mail Australia as Bradley James Brooks, was arrested in nearby Halekulani on Monday night and charged with murder . Police are investigating whether the earlier incident involving a woman is linked to the fatal knife attack . Family and friends have paid their respects to a 'top bloke' who loved travelling, partying and going to festivals .

Tiger Woods will be accompanied by his two children when he plays the traditional three-par tournament . Gene Sarazen played the most impressive shot in the tournament's history with an albatross on the 15th hole . Rory McIlroy will impress us all if he completes his career Grand Slam in dramatic fashion .

Former US president George H.W. Bush looked in good health on Friday as he accompanied Australian tennis player Roy Emerson at the U.S. Men's Clay Court Championship in Houston, Texas . Bush, 90, fell ill in December and was hospitalized after complaining of shortness of breath .

Dzhokhar Tsarnaev kept his hands folded in front of him and looked down at the defence table as the guilty verdicts were read . The jury will now decide whether the 21-year-old former student should be sentenced to death or receive life in prison . Tsarnaev's conviction was widely expected, given his lawyer's startling admission during opening statements that he took part in the bombing .

Barcelona will make a £50m bid for Paul Pogba, according to Spanish press reports . Barcelona plan to let the midfielder stay in Italy for a year on loan . Lionel Messi has recovered from a foot problem to start for Barca against Celta Vigo on Sunday . Real Madrid can count on winning the La Liga title if they win their final 10 games . Benfica boss Jorge Jesus says Nicolas Gaitan is a star of different characteristics to his other players with no equal .

Carlos Tevez opened the scoring for Juventus in the 17th minute as they beat Lazio 2-0 in Turin . Leonardo Bonucci sealed the win for the Italian champions with his 26th goal of the season . The result leaves Juventus 15 points clear of second place in Serie A with seven games remaining . Lazio's run of six consecutive wins has ended their six consecutive league wins .

Aston Villa host Liverpool in the FA Cup semi-final at Wembley on Sunday . Tim Sherwood has been a fan of Raheem Sterling since he was 14 and on the books at QPR . The 20-year-old has been pictured smoking a shisha pipe with team-mate Jordon Ibe earlier this season . The Aston Villa boss believes his side can cause a shock at Wembley .

The 27-year-old singer was at the Coachella music festival in Indio, California . The clip appears to show her holding a suspicious white tube in her hands and holding her nose for several seconds . Speculation has been rife as to what exactly is going on in the video . It has been claimed Rihanna posted a comment on Instagram claiming it was a joint .

English Bulldog named Hazel is no exception to this rule, as demonstrated in her attempts to get the better of a washing basket . The video begins erratically with the dog flying through the air and jumping onto the basket . Pausing to look at the camera from within the basket, Hazel leans up against the side of it . Suddenly her weight causes the basket to fall onto its side and send her and some clothes sprawling onto the floor .

Aaron Cook's application to switch allegiances to Moldova has been approved . The 24-year-old applied for citizenship earlier this month after receiving funding from Moldovan billionaire Igor Iuzefovici . Dorset-born Cook was overlooked for the Great Britain taekwondo squad at London 2012 . British Olympic chief Bill Sweeney insists the association worked 'really hard' to keep Cook on board .

Wojciech Szczesny will start in goal for Arsenal against Reading at Wembley on Saturday . Arsene Wenger admits that Szczny lost his place to David Ospina after a number of errors this season . The Polish international has made just three appearances since an error-strewn display at Southampton on New Year’s Day . He infuriated Wenger after the game by puffing on a cigarette in the showers .

Vincent Kompany, Manuel Pellegrini and Patrick Vieira were in attendance to watch Manchester City's Under 18s side fall to a 3-1 defeat by Chelsea in the FA Youth Cup final final first-leg on Monday night . Chelsea striker Tammy Abraham fired Chelsea ahead in the seventh minute with a stunning volley . Isaac Buckley and Tammy Abraham both scored for the visitors before half-time . Chelsea's first-team are currently top of the Premier League table, while Manchester City are fourth .

Jose Mourinho was visibly surprised by a question he was asked at his Chelsea press conference on Friday . Mourinho was asked how hard Arsene Wenger pushed him in the title race and their clash last season . The Chelsea boss responded to the question with an ambiguous answer . Mourinho burst into laughter, covered his mouth in shock and swore at the question .

Emmanuel Adebayor could be allowed to leave Tottenham on a free transfer . The Togolese striker is currently on a £5.2million-per-season salary . The 31-year-old hasn't been a regular under Mauricio Pochettino . Tottenham would still like to receive a fee for the striker but they just want rid of his wages .

Quade Cooper has agreed a two-year deal with French club Toulon . The Queensland Reds fly-half has won 53 caps for Australia . Cooper will link up with former Wallabies playmaker Matt Giteau . Bernard Foley is favourite to wear the Wallabies number 10 shirt for their World Cup campaign .

Stuart McCall is compiling a dossier of transfer targets for next season . Rangers boss says he is already talking to agents and putting things in place for if and when . McCall still does not know if he will be in charge beyond the current campaign . Rangers have operated a haphazard transfer policy since re-emerging from liquidation .

Manchester City will not compromise on quality in their search for homegrown players this summer . Manuel Pellegrini will ask about Raheem Sterling's availability even if Liverpool are likely to refuse to sell him . The Premier League champions need eight homegrown players for their first-team squad next season . Frank Lampard, Scott Sinclair and Micah Richards will all leave while Richard Wright is expected to follow, and James Milner will decide his fate at the end of the season .

Rangers skipper Lee McCulloch was booed for an error that led to a goal against Raith Rovers . Rangers manager Stuart McCall has had to get used to his players being booed . McCall hopes McCulloch will be the last player to get booed at Ibrox .

Floyd Mayweather Jnr insists on eating organic food before his fight against Manny Pacquiao . Chef Quiana Jeffries, aka Chef Q, has been cooking for Mayweather since his fight for Manny Pacquaio was announced . Mayweather's most unhealthy food craving is 'fried hot dogs... with barbecue sauce' Jeffries also has to cope with Mayweather's unconventional timekeeping . The champ's 24-hour chef charges around £1,000 per meal .

Nancy Perry will no longer teach students at Dublin Middle School in Georgia and will retire at the end of the year . Perry is alleged to have told students that Obama is a Muslim and that any parent who support him couldn't be Christian, either . A 12-year-old boy in Perry's class brought the matter to the attention of his father, Jimmie Scott, who complained to the school . Scott said he immediately requested a parent-teacher conference to which Perry brought along her husband Bill, who sits on the county Board of Education . Instead of discussing Perry's classroom comments, Perry and her husband showed him what he described as anti-Obama internet propaganda .

Manchester United scouts checked on Porto striker Jackson Martinez last week . The 28-year-old wants to leave Portugal this summer and his club will listen to offers of around £30million . The Colombia international came close to joining AC Milan in January but the club failed to agree a fee . Manchester United are looking to add two strikers this summer . Burnley's Danny Ings remains an option and they have considered Edinson Cavani .

Chinese made decorations 'likely to contravene food imitation safety rules' The eggs bear a striking similarity to the sugar-coated chocolate treats with a brown 'speckle' designed to make it look like a quail's egg . The eggs have now been withdrawn nationwide ahead of the Easter break . Trading Standards officials in Buckinghamshire and Surrey raised the alarm over the decorations .

Members of banned leftist group - known as the DHKP-C - took senior Turkish prosecutor Mehmet Selim Kiraz hostage last week . Both the prosecutor and the hostage takers were killed after a police shoot-out . The British national, of Polish origin, was arrested on Saturday as part of an operation against the Revolutionary People's Liberation Party-Front, according to reports .

The echidna was spotted paddling out to sea off Rye Beach, a popular surfing spot on the Mornington Peninsula, 83 km south of Melbourne . The prickly Australian mammal was filmed using its ant-eating snout as a snorkle . Echidnas, like many native Australian animals, are actually 'proficient' swimmers .

M&S clothing sales up 0.7% - first rise after 14 consecutive quarters of losses . Fashion supremo Belinda Earl credited with helping bring in a number of sales hits . The £199 suede skirt, worn by Alexa Chung and Olivia Palermo, is now being branded the item that could save the business . Celebrities like Rosie Huntington-Whiteley and David Gandy have also helped boost sales .

Theodosia Aresti, 71, moved into a new-build flat in London five years ago . But a blocked pipe unleashed a 'tsunami of sewage' from the nine-storey building's 239 other flats into her flat . Pensioner's nightmare began when she noticed a foul smell coming from her bathroom . She discovered an unidentifiable brown substance bubbling up through the plughole in her bath . But worse was to come when the toilet began overflowing 'like a volcano' and flooded her flat in the process .

Lisa Williams, 49, hit taxi driver David Coleman, 54, three times with hammer during street fight . The two families had been 'neighbours at war' since the Colemans moved in next door to Williams' home in 2007 . Williams, from Chingford, London, was jailed for 30 months at Snaresbrook Crown Court . She was found guilty of maliciously wounding Mr Coleman after a trial in February .

The Dalny Vostock sank in the Sea of Okhotsk at 4am on Thursday morning local time . More than 1,300 fishermen and emergency staff are involved in the rescue operation . At the latest count there are 13 people still missing after the trawler tipped over when a fishing net was pulled in .

Prescott, Arizona City Attorney Jon Paladini claims the sole survivor, lookout Brendan McDonough, heard the leader of the Granite Mountain Hotshots order the crew to leave a safe spot where the fire had already burned . He says the order came just before winds whipped Yarnell Hill into a deadly, all encompassing firestorm in June 2013, the worst disaster of its kind since 1933 . But neither he nor the lone survivor nor the city's former chief of woodland fires for the city are alive enough to verify the claim . The revelation may change the outcome of a wrongful death suit filed by the families of a dozen on the hotshots last June accusing the state of negligence .

Four men have been moved out of intensive care after suspected drug overdoses during a party cruise on Sydney Harbour . The men collapsed on the vessel on Good Friday, forcing it to dock near the Opera House . One man is suspected of taking up to four ecstasy pills in one hit, including blue ones with scissor stamps on them, a friend told police . Police say they discovered cocaine, marijuana and MDMA before the boat left King Street Wharf at noon .

Ana Granucci Davis, 28, wife of St Petersburg chef Aaron Davis, 31, gave birth to their son Andrew Aaron Lawrence on Tuesday . Mr Davis, head chef at The Kitchen, was fatally struck by 25-year-old Jason Lanard Mitchell on Saturday around 2am, according to police . Mitchell faces several charges including DUI manslaughter, vehicular homicide, aggravated fleeing and eluding, leaving the scene of a crash involving a death, DUI serious bodily injury and trying to escape from police headquarters .

Neuroscientists at UCLA examined the brains of 90 women, 44 of whom took the Pill . They found the lateral orbitofrontal cortex and the posterior cigulate cortex were thinner in those taking the contraception . They believe it could account for increased anxiety and depressive symptoms . Synthetic hormones found in the Pill cause these alterations in brain structure and function .

Christy Mack, 23, was left with 18 broken bones, a broken nose, a ruptured kidney, ruptured liver, missing teeth, and a fractured rib . Now, nine months later, she has to wear a wig and glasses, and is still undergoing dental work . She claims Jonathan Paul Koppenhaver, 33, became abusive four months into their one-year relationship . He allegedly cut off her mohawk with a kitchen knife in August 2014 attack . He has been charged with attempted murder and will be tried later this fall . He maintains his innocence and says he was also a victim .

Emma Dickson, 31, developed blood clots in her pelvis, which then moved to her lungs and caused a pulmonary embolism, which caused her left lung to collapse . Doctors told her she had developed the clot as a result of taking the contraceptive pill . The pill contains a synthetic version of oestrogen which can very slightly thicken the blood, leading to clots . There was also a risk the clots could have travelled to her brain, causing a stroke . She was in a wheelchair after being discharged from hospital and must take blood thinning drugs for the rest of her life to reduce the risk of further clots developing .

Brad Reynolds, 38, is TripAdvisor's most active user with 66,000 contributions in just five years . He has posted reviews from 394 cities and 46 countries, with a map claiming he has travelled more than 600,000 miles and visited a third of the world . The Oklahoma native averages nearly two reviews a day, spending up to an hour on each one . So far he has given just 12 one-star ('terrible') ratings, and he has handed out five-star reviews to top attractions .

Nasa has released an infographic explaining which worlds in the solar system are thought to have subsurface oceans . Nine other worlds in total are now suspected to have some form of water under their surface . This includes Europa and Ganymede, where water is thought to be melting beneath its surface . It follows claims by Dr Ellen Stofan, chief scientist for Nasa, that we could find life in the next ten or 20 years .

Cleopatra was known for her love of perfume, liberally applying lotus and rose oil to her upper lip . Perfumes with a bright, breezy, citrus scent evoke images of health, youth and the outdoors . We react in an involuntary way to smell because our noses are connected to synapses in the unconscious part of the brain (the piriform cortex), which governs the subconscious mind .

Labour leader said the bobby on the beat is 'at risk of disappearing', while serious criminals 'are being let off the hook' He said the police are 'struggling to keep up' with rise in child sexual exploitation, terrorism and online crime while public safety is being 'put at risk' by a chaotic prison and probation system . Police and crime commissioners (PCCs) would be axed to help fund the £800 million plan to guarantee neighbourhood policing across England and Wales . Labour said new laws would introduce a local policing commitment that required forces to guarantee community policing .

Daniel Boykin, 33, pleaded guilty to charges of unlawful photography, aggravated burglary, wiretapping, unlawful telephone recording and two computer crimes . He was sentenced to six months prison on Thursday . Boykin admitted to repeatedly filming the woman inside a bathroom at Nashville International Airport . At the time of his arrest last year, Boykin was found with 92 videos of the victim — 29 taken from the airport bathroom — and 1,527 photographs . He also took photos of her clothing and stole pictures from her electronic devices .

Percentage of atheists across the globe is expected to fall across the same time frame . Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2070 according to a report by the Pew Research Center . Christians in the US will decline from three quarters of population in 2010 to two thirds in 2050, it is claimed . Those who do not affiliate with any religion, including atheists and agnostics, will make up a 'declining share of population'

The House In The Sea sits right on the beach in Newquay and can only be reached by crossing a 90ft-high suspension bridge . The interiors are a luxurious mix of sleek neutrals and modern design, with panoramic sea views at every turn . The master bedroom is connected by a private staircase and comes complete with a sprawling four poster bed .

Sam Smith was travelling from Minneapolis to Indiana on business last Thursday when the harrowing encounter took place . The driver, from Illinois, begins filming with the tornado just a few hundred yards in front of him . He says: 'This is a tornado and I cannot tell which way it is going. So I don't know how to get away from it' Fortunately the tornado passes leaving Mr Smith unharmed and his truck intact . Storm Prediction Center in Oklahoma advises you to 'avoid seeking shelter under bridges'

Former US President Bill Clinton says he believes he has lost his natural flair for political campaigning, adding that becoming a grandparent to his daughter Chelsea's six-month-old daughter Charlotte has tamed the angry side of his personality which once helped to propel him to victory . The 68-year-old added that his role in his wife's 2008 campaign was a source of tension in the Clinton camp .

Jesse Kidder was in a patrol car chasing Michael Wilcox, 27, in New Richmond, Ohio . Kidder had only been on the police force for a year when he was confronted by Wilcox . Wilcox ran at Kidder and asked him to shoot, but he refused and said: 'I don't want to' Eventually Wilcox surrendered and lay on the ground with his hands outstretched as backup arrived .

Shinjiro Kumagai is a 'mild mannered' clergyman at a local Buddhist temple called Gokurakuji in Kitakyushu, southwest Japan . But after the days work is done, he dresses up as sci-fi TV hero Kamen Rider 1 and takes to the streets to lay down the law . Bizarre images depict him riding around in full superhero gear - which makes him appear like a giant grasshopper- and the trademark Cyclone motorcycle fitted with fake jets .

Ten friends, including the dead men, had rented a house on Caspar Cove 160 miles north of San Francisco to hunt for abalone, a rare and expensive mollusk that is prized as a delicacy . Witnesses said at least some of the men appeared to be inexperienced abalone divers who chose rough, choppy waters near several dangerous rock outcroppings to dive . The three men who drowned were overcome by the churning water and crushed against the sharp rocks on shore .

Syriza party says Germany owes Greece nearly 279billion euros, or £204billion . The German government says the issue was resolved legally years ago . Greece suffered a brutal occupation at the hands of Hitler’s forces in 1941 . More than 40,000 people are believed to have starved to death in Athens alone .

Scott Kemery, 44, was rushed by helicopter to Stony Brook University Hospital on Long Island with first and second degree burns after accidentally setting himself on fire on Tuesday . Police said that Kemery started the blaze with his ill-timed cigarette break in the parking lot of the King Kullen supermarket in Eastport .

Murderer Robert Donovan, 57, walked out of Ford Open Prison in Arundel, Sussex, in 2010 . It took police four years to alert the public after he walked out without permission . Ministry of Justice responded to Freedom of Information request and revealed names of 29 missing since 2004 . They include those who failed to return from temporary release and those who simply walked out .

Aidan Fraley, 16, said he believes everyone on the Tulsa force is to blame for his father the April 2 death of Eric Harris and says 'they should all go down' Robert Bates, 73, mistakenly thought he was holding a Taser, not his handgun, when he fatally shot Eric Harris on April 2 as he lay on the ground . Bates has been charged with second-degree manslaughter .

The University of Wisconsin Badgers beat the University of Kentucky Wildcats 71-64 in Saturday night's NCAA semi-final game . The Wildcats were kicked out of the NCAA tournament after losing to the Badgers in Indianapolis . The Badgers will now face off against Duke in the NCAA final on Monday - the school's first final since 1941 .

Ex-Bolton Wanderers striker Delroy Facey, 34, denies conspiracy to commit bribery . He is accused of acting as a middleman for two men convicted of match-fixing . Former non-league player Moses Swaibu, 25, also denies the charges at Birmingham Crown Court . The Crown alleges the plot targeted the lower leagues because of the high level of scrutiny surrounding the Premier League .

Lord Janner, 86, has repeatedly denied claims he abused young boys at care homes . Police have interviewed more than 20 men who claim they were abused by the Labour peer . But Alison Saunders, Director of Public Prosecutions, ruled it was not in the public interest to put him on trial because of his age and ill health . Janner's wife Myra died in 1996 and he has not been seen outside his flat in Hampstead, London, since police investigating claims of historic sexual abuse raided it in 2013 .

Bronze-working had not been developed at this time in Alaska, and the artefacts were created in China, Korea or Yakutia . Researchers believe those who lived at the Rising Whale site may be part of the 'Birnirk' culture . This is a group of people who lived on both sides of the Bering Strait and used skin boats and harpoons to hunt whales . The latest discovery backs up earlier evidence for trade between Alaska and other civilisations prior to 1492 .

'Reenactment MfS' - the Ministry for State Security better known as the 'Stasi' during the 40 year existence of the East German state - is a new book containing these photos of desperation . The socialist rulers used the pictures as evidence in the show trials against those they caught . They were also thought to have been used for training purposes for border guards and trainee agents .

Dr Sameer Patel, clinical director at the Elleven practice in London's Harley Street, has highlighted the dentistry dangers of the 'desk diet' Here, he reveals the biggest offenders, and offers advice on how to safeguard your oral health . Dr Patel said some breakfast cereals contain as many as three teaspoons of sugar per serving .

Yvonne Camargo, 39, of Victorville, California, was arrested on suspicion of willful cruelty to a child on April 3 but it is unknown as to if she was charged . The video was filmed April 1 in a parking lot after a man identifying as Edward Moneyhanz on Youtube saw the woman 'pulling this kid by his hair out of the khols store' Camargo is oblivious to the fact that she is being filmed until the cameraman and another woman begin asking her what she's doing .

Prime Minister will hail the 'jobs miracle' that has seen 1,000 new jobs created every day . He will claim Ed Miliband's economic policies could see 'a million more people joining the dole queues' Last night, head of the International Monetary Fund picked out the UK recovery as exemplary .

Fireman Stephen Hunt, 38, died after he and a colleague got into difficulties battling a fire started at Paul's Hair World in Manchester's Northern Quarter on July 13, 2013 . The girl - who was just 15 at the time - is said to have dropped a cigarette to the floor while standing near the shop's fire exit which rolled underneath the door and set boxes alight . She was originally charged with arson being reckless as to whether life was endangered, but was cleared having been due to stand trial on Monday . A judge said she was 'guilty only of being careless'

A video of a crocodile swimming through a public marina with a dead pet dog locked in between its jaws has been viewed more than half a million times online . The clip shows a large croc calmly moving through the marina in the tourist hotspot of Puerto Vallarta, in Mexico, with a black dog wearing a red collar lifeless in its mouth . New Zealander Tim Weston was on holiday with his wife when he saw the alarming sight . He said the dog belonged to the local bike shop's owner .

Box truck collided with a car on Interstate 93 southbound in the city's Dorchester neighborhood at about 6am . Both drivers were taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries . Replacement shuttle buses were run for southbound passengers with long queues forming . Even after the truck was towed by crane at about 8:30am, traffic remained backed up in both directions .

Hamm, 44, was allegedly involved in a hazing scandal at the University of Texas at Austin in 1990 . Allegedly set fire to one pledge after viciously beating him and using a claw hammer to drag him by his genitals . He was eventually charged with assault in connection with the sadistic November 1990 initiation, but he managed to get the charges dismissed before he began his ascent to superstardom .

The unnamed woman has been placed in an isolation ward at Canberra Hospital for treatment on Friday . Health officials say it's most unlikely she has Ebola and her symptoms - a fever and stomach upset - are consistent with many other conditions . The woman did not treat any cases of the deadly virus where she worked at an Ebola treatment clinic in Liberia before arriving in Australia on April 5 . She is being treated in complete isolation in a single room under the hospital's Ebola protocol .

On Saturday a 29-year-old man was admitted to Bundaberg Hospital suffering from fractures, head injuries and burns . Initial police inquiries were to do with the theft of the man’s car . However, after observing his injuries at the hospital, police started their own investigation despite the victim claiming to have amnesia and that he could not remember what happened to him . A 32-year old man from suburban Kepnock is due to appear in court on Monday on charges including grievous bodily harm and torture .

Naomi Jacobs had Transient Global Amnesia, a form of memory loss brought on by stress . The last thing she could remember was falling asleep in her bunk bed as a schoolgirl . She thought it was 1992, John Major was prime minister and she was about to sit her GCSEs . Mobile phones were still the size of a house brick, the internet a mystery - and her 10-year-old son was a stranger . After eight weeks her memory began to return to normal .

Mancunian Neil Killham, 32, has made his own version of the infamous shepherds pie-trifle . He posted a picture of the clashing ingredients on Twitter with the caption: 'It's finally time. I'm making The Trifle Out Of Friends' He said: 'I thought I'd be able to compartmentalise the flavours, but I cannot' Friends character Rachel Green accidentally made the disgusting concoction on the show .

BMW Group’s answer to Google Glass is designed to let drivers of its Mini model see pop-up virtual displays for showing maps and other features . The Augmented Vision goggles will go on show at the Auto Shanghai show and generate ‘screens’ showing information that only the wearer can see . The goggles can project navigation information with arrows onto the roads, as well as show speed limits and even point out local landmarks . They are connected to a smartphone so that wearers see an icon when they have a new text message, which can be read out in the car . And the glasses also give drivers X-ray-like vision, by letting users see external objects concealed by the

Sandra Malcolm's body was discovered at her home in Cape Town, South Africa . Reports in South Africa suggest the 74-year-old's attackers had mutilated her . She was found on Sunday morning at the Capri Mews complex in the Marina Da Gama area of the city . The pensioner had been planning to return to Scotland next month to visit family .

Robert Butler, 43, was transported inside a shipping container from Bannister House in Providence, Rhode Island to the Eleanor Slater Hospital in Cranston . The operation took almost seven hours on Sunday and involved the Providence and Cranston fire departments, Lifespan, the Hospital Association of Rhode Island and Bay Crane Northeast . Mr Butler was accompanied by his medical team to monitor his health .

Beauty High's Rolly Robinson, from the blog Beauty High, stars in theunique makeover clip, which sees him transform himself into a Kylie Jenner lookalike with the help of various make-up products and - of course - the infamous lip suction cup .

Scott Keyes, 28, is about to travel 20,000miles on 21 flights in first class... without paying a penny . The Think Progress reporter reveals his travel hacks in his eBooks How To Fly For Free and How To Find Cheap Flights . Keyes recommends credit cards are the best way to go if you want to quickly and easily rack up frequent flyer miles .

LaTasha Gosling and her two daughters, Janyaa, 4, and Jenika, 8, and her son Landen, 7, were discovered early Wednesday one day after they were reported missing . The suspect in the case was found just hours later dead, and while police would not say how he died they did say that it was not a homicide . He also had a six-month-old baby with him who was unharmed . Police have yet to release much information at this time, only saying that the suspect and victim did know one another .

Missoula: Rape and The Justice System in a College Town, a Doubleday publication that was released Tuesday, sparked a fierce debate in Montana and beyond . Krakauer, the author of the critically acclaimed book Into the Wild, sat down for an interview with ABC's Nightline, which aired Wednesday night, to discuss his latest project exploring the sensitive subject of campus rape . He interviewed five alleged victims of rape for his book, including Kelsey Belnap, Allison Huguet and Hillary McLaughlin .

Calf is being fed three times a day at dairy farm in Narnaul, northern India . He has been called Nandi - a nickname for Lord Krishna - in Hindu culture . He is attracting a stream of visitors wanting to celebrate him and pray at his feet . Last month a bull with two faces was sold to an abattoir in Queensland, Australia .

Mary Doyle Keefe, who posed for Norman Rockwell's Rosie the Riveter painting as a 19-year-old telephone operator, has died in Simsbury, Conneticut, aged 92 . She was paid $10 (equivalent to $136 today) for two sessions she posed for Rockwell and his photographer, Gene Pelham .

Chinese scientists have reported a 23 per cent reduction in short-sightedness in children who spend an extra 40 minutes a day in the sunshine . Scientists had though reading or looking at a screen could cause shortsightedness, but now think it could be down to a lack of natural light while taking part in these activities .

A heated exchange between Royals starter Yordano Ventura and White Sox outfielder Adam Eaton sparked the brawl which saw players from both dugouts and bullpens flood the field . Several punches were thrown and Ventura, Lorenzo Cain and Edinson Volquez were ejected along with Chicago's Chris Sale and Jeff Samardzija . Royals won the game 3-2 in 13 innings, which is the first of a four-game series .

Linda and George Hunter raised their four children in their home in Garrick Street, Wavertree, Liverpool . But eight years ago, the street became part of a regeneration scheme . The council bought properties and boarded them up ready for demolition . Despite neighbours moving out, the Hunters stayed put as they had elderly parents living nearby . Now the Hunters feel trapped as property prices have dramatically fallen in the area . Estate agents say the couple would struggle to sell their home for much more than £1 .

A 17-year-old driver who held her license for one day crashed into a wheelie bin before smashing into a brick wall and leaving five injured . The driver and a passenger were taken to hospital in a serious condition while the other three were stable . The group of five were travelling in a white Mitsubishi Lancer along Anderson Road in Glenning Valley on the Central Coast of NSW when she lost control over her vehicle on Thursday night . Debris, clothing and bricks were scattered around the crashed vehicle .

Lincolnshire resort joins St Ives and Windermere in top ten league of towns for holiday property . Billy Butlin located his first holiday park at Skegness in 1936 and it still attracts 400,000 visitors a year . Research reveals 165,000 people in England and Wales have holiday homes . Cornwall, with its 300 mile coastline, is the nation's holiday home hotspot .

Hannah Wilson, 22, was last seen at about 1am on Friday and her body was found in a rural area of Brown County in Needmore, Indiana . Daniel Messel, 49, of Bloomington, was arrested after a police investigation and he is facing a preliminary murder charge . Brown County Coroner Earl Piper said Wilson was struck three or four times in the back of the head with an unknown object, which was not found at the scene . The connection between Messel and Wilson is unclear, police said .

Protein World's billboard campaign features a svelte bikini-clad model asking 'Are you beach body ready?' The company is facing a massive backlash over its billboard campaign . More than 50,000 people have signed a petition to have them removed and a demonstration planned for this weekend in protest . The Advertising Standards Authority confirmed it had received 277 complaints . Many of the posters have been vandalised with feminist slogans such as ‘Your body is not a commodity’

Prime Minister has written to First Great Western (FGW) to request it 'urgently review' increase . He has promised to freeze fares in real terms for the whole of the next parliament . Passengers travelling from Charlbury, Oxfordshire, will be forced to pay £62.40 if they want to come home on one of these trains . From May 17, these customers will pay up to 87% - an increase from £33.30 . Mr Cameron's constituents in Witney constituency are angered by the planned changes .

John Sims, who had Burkitt's Lymphoma, died on Saturday, with his new wife Lindsey Sims by his side . The pair married March 21 at the University of Texas M.D. Anderson Cancer Center after John, who was to turn 31 tomorrow, was told his cancer was terminal . After the wedding they set off on a a cross-country road trip last week hoping to make it to visit John's friend Dave in Oregon . But their journey came to an end when John's condition worsened and they had to go to a hospice in Grand Junction, Colorado .
